SELECT car_makers.FullName, car_makers.Id
FROM car_makers
JOIN model_list ON model_list.Maker = car_makers.Id
JOIN car_names ON car_names.Make = model_list.Model
GROUP BY car_makers.Id, car_makers.FullName
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT car_names.MakeId) > 3;
FINAL SQL:
SELECT car_makers.FullName, car_makers.Id
FROM car_makers
JOIN model_list ON model_list.Maker = car_makers.Id
JOIN car_names ON car_names.Make = model_list.Model
GROUP BY car_makers.Id, car_makers.FullName
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT car_names.MakeId) > 3;
